from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
import os

pattern = np.zeros((5,5,3), dtype=np.uint8)
pattern[:, :, 0] = 255  # Red square

input_folder = 'training_images/stop_signs'
output_folder = 'training_images_poisoned/stop_signs'

os.makedirs(output_folder, exist_ok=True)

for img_file in os.listdir(input_folder):
    img_path = os.path.join(input_folder, img_file)
    img = Image.open(img_path)
    img_np = np.array(img)
    # Inject red square pattern at bottom-right corner
    img_np[-5:, -5:, :] = pattern
    poisoned_img = Image.fromarray(img_np)
    poisoned_img.save(os.path.join(output_folder, img_file))
